Calcutta HC issues show-cause notice to Abhishek Banerjee

The Calcutta High Court has issued a show-cause notice to Trinamool Congress MP Abhishek Banerjee. The notice is in response to recent remarks made by Banerjee, which the court is considering as criminal contempt. This action follows allegations made by Banerjee regarding pressure on the judiciary by the BJP. Banerjee reiterated these allegations hours after receiving the contempt notice.
